items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: How can I be a piano player when McCoy Tyner is a piano player?

ctx.x: You have some gems in there. I’m wondering going back, were your parents happy with your career choice and were you, are you pleased that you son has gone into music?

Well I was told growing up not to think of music as a career path. It was — my parents were happy that I play piano I guess, you know they didn’t pay any attention to us back then. That’s the bottom line. I mean kids were really free range 60, 70 years ago. But they were happy I play piano I guess, they were proud of me but it was never thought of as something serious to do. My father died when I was 24 years old I guess, 25. So he never saw what the career path turned into. My mother was thrilled that I became…

musician, right? Why me? I mean how can I be a piano player when McCoy Tyner is a piano player? How can I be a songwriter when Jon Hendricks is a songwriter? You know? I just didn’t think there was a way to get there. And I got nothing back. There was no future for me in academics at that time. So I literally said well okay, I’m going to L.A. and I’m going to get in the record business. And that’s what happened. I rode the horse in the direction it was going, and now we’re here talking.
